help_quickstart_scan_desc: Go to the Games page and click "Scan All" to detect installed games from Steam and Epic Games. You can also add games manually by pointing to their executable.
help_quickstart_monitor_desc: Click "Start" in the monitoring widget in the sidebar. GameRoute will automatically detect when a monitored game is running and capture network connections.
help_quickstart_sessions_desc: A session is created each time a monitored game is detected. It records server IPs, traceroutes, and network quality data until the game closes.
help_glossary_asn_desc: A unique identifier for a group of IP networks managed by one or more operators. Helps identify which network provider owns an IP address.
help_glossary_ttl_desc: A counter that limits the lifespan of a network packet. Each router decrements the TTL by one. Traceroute uses this to discover each hop along the route.
help_glossary_traceroute_desc: A network diagnostic tool that maps the path packets take from your computer to a server. It reveals each router (hop) along the way and measures latency at each step.
help_glossary_problem_hop_desc: A router along the traceroute path that shows significantly higher latency (>50ms increase) or packet loss (>10%). This may indicate a network bottleneck.
help_glossary_ip_period_desc: A continuous time window during which your game communicated with a specific server IP. Multiple periods can exist for the same IP within one session.
help_glossary_packet_loss_desc: The percentage of network packets that fail to reach their destination. High packet loss causes lag, rubber-banding, and disconnections in games.
help_faq_no_geo: Why do some IPs have no geolocation?
help_faq_no_geo_answer: Geolocation data comes from third-party databases that may not cover all IPs. Private or recently allocated IPs often lack location information.
help_faq_manual_game: How do I add a game manually?
help_faq_manual_game_answer: Go to the Games page, click "Add Game", enter the game name and browse to select the game's executable file (.exe on Windows, .app on macOS).
help_faq_high_latency_answer: High latency can be caused by geographic distance to the server, network congestion, ISP routing issues, or problems at specific hops along the route. Check the Network page to identify patterns.
help_faq_no_data_collection_answer: No. GameRoute does not collect any personal data. All your session data, game library, and network analysis are stored locally on your machine in a SQLite database and are never transmitted to any server. ASN and geolocation lookups happen entirely offline via a bundled GeoLite2 database (see the Data & Attributions section below).
help_data_description: GameRoute resolves ASN, ISP, and geolocation data for every hop using an IP intelligence database bundled with the app. All lookups happen locally on your machine — no queries are sent to any external service.
help_data_maxmind_desc: This product includes GeoLite2 Data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com. The databases are refreshed with each GameRoute release (typically every 1–2 weeks) and licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
welcome_subtitle: Monitor your game network connections in real time.
welcome_admin_title: Why does it need admin privileges?
welcome_admin_body: Network packet capture (pktmon) and traceroute require elevated privileges. The capture service runs as a Windows service — you only see a UAC prompt at install time.
welcome_privacy_body: All session data is stored in a local SQLite database on your machine. The only external call is to ip-api.com for IP geolocation and ASN resolution.
welcome_no_collection_body: No telemetry, no user accounts, no cloud sync, no personal data collection. GameRoute is fully offline except for IP lookups.
welcome_launch_on_startup_description: Start GameRoute automatically when you log in, minimized to the system tray. You can change this later in Settings.
welcome_advanced_mode_description: Show technical details like protocols, hostnames, and packet counts. You can change this later in Settings.
service_warning_body: The network monitoring service is not active. Some game connections may not be detected.
service_warning_fix_error: Could not restart the service. Try reinstalling the app or running it as administrator.
session_game_servers_hint: These are likely game servers based on UDP traffic lasting over 30 seconds. Compare durations with your actual play time to confirm.
